verdict.rationale: Content was successfully extracted from multiple edd.ca.gov guidance pages (e-Services for Business, file-and-pay, payroll taxes), and the 404s on llms.txt and OpenAPI paths show that host answers a keyless agent normally rather than walling it. The probe notes describe these guidance pages as open. The 403 is limited to the separate transactional portal host (eddservices.edd.ca.gov), which is not the public reading surface. Missing for 10: an explicit recorded HTTP 200 and user agent for the guidance pages themselves, confirmation that the content is server-rendered rather than a JS-only shell, and independent corroboration of no CAPTCHA or bot challenge.
